$comment: PHASE 5.3 narrator compositions. A state is a recipe over the asset layers (DECISIONS.md ADR-004), not an asset. Validated by scripts/validation/validate_compositions.py.

talking.description: Default speaking state. Neutral stance, mouth driven by the viseme track.
talking.notes: The state a narration returns to between beats.

explaining.description: Engaged speaking state. Body leans in, warm expression, mouth driven by the viseme track.
explaining.notes: Uses the friendly expression, not the explaining expression - the latter has an open mouth and cannot host a viseme track.

presenting.description: Offering or introducing. Open palms, positive expression, mouth driven by the viseme track.
presenting.notes: Hands are fully in frame; upper-body framing is required, not optional.

reaction.description: Non-speaking beat. A startled recoil held for emphasis.
reaction.notes: The surprised expression carries its own open mouth, so no viseme track is applied. Silence by design.

emphasis.description: Non-speaking beat. An energetic punctuation between sentences.
emphasis.notes: The excited expression carries its own open mouth. Hold briefly; it reads as caricature if sustained.
